payload.title: ClimateDISK: Hockey stick
payload.description: This notebook follows the WINGS steps to reproduce the 'hockey stick' climate figure, allowing for updates with new data. It involves querying data, processing it to remove duplicates, slicing it for a specific time frame, Gaussianizing the values, and creating a composite plot.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries for data processing and visualization.
steps.title: Import Libraries

steps.description: Query the LiPDverse v3 graph to retrieve climate data.
steps.title: Data Query

steps.description: Remove duplicate rows based on specific criteria to ensure data integrity.
steps.title: Remove Duplicate Rows

steps.description: Slice the data for the time frame of interest using Pyleoclim.
steps.title: Slice for Time Frame

steps.description: Gaussianize the sliced data to prepare it for further analysis.
steps.title: Gaussianize Data

steps.description: Create a composite by cleaning proxy/variable names, setting figure styles, and calibrating against instrumental data.
steps.title: Create Composite
